title: evidence-bundle.json
description: The signed public artifact at the root of a VIGIL proof bundle. Reflects the object written by proof.bundle.export_bundle / `python -m framework.v2 evidence certify`: a set of SignedEvidence certificates, the hash chain over their cert_digests (in order), and the governance-signed chain head. The chain's cert_digest sequence MUST equal the certificates' cert_digests, in order (nothing suppressed/injected/reordered).

oneOf.description: An UNSIGNED bundle (no --signer). Then only chain linkage is checkable, not governance authenticity.
